body:
Mula v1.2.49 hanggang v1.2.60: i-install lang ang update, hindi na kailangang i-uninstall.
Mula v1.2.48 o mas luma: i-uninstall muna ang lumang E-Tarabay. Babalik ang stars, awards at progress pagka-sign in ulit.

From v1.2.49 to v1.2.60: just install the update. From v1.2.48 or older: uninstall the old E-Tarabay first; your stars, awards and progress come back when you sign in.

I-download / Download: https://jaijr711.github.io/etarabay-releases/

Pagka-update

- Wala nang kailangang gawin ngayon.
- Sa susunod na update, pindutin lang ang "I-update" sa app. Sa unang beses, payagan ang E-Tarabay na mag-install ("Allow from this source"), saka bumalik sa app.
- Puwede mo nang burahin ang mga lumang E-Tarabay.apk sa Downloads para lumuwag ang storage.

Bago

- Sa loob na ng app nangyayari ang update. Hindi na dumadaan sa website, at wala nang naiipong E-Tarabay.apk sa Downloads na pumupuno sa storage.
- Mula sa susunod na update, ang binago lang ang dina-download: kadalasan ilang MB lang, hindi na 117 MB.
- Ipinapakita ng update ang laki nito bago i-download, at ang progress habang nagda-download.
- Sa Awards, isang pindot na lang para kunin ang medalya. May gintong ilaw, tunog at pag-unlock, at lumilipad ito pabalik sa estante.
- Naka-lock muna ang medalyang naghihintay hanggang kunin, at kumikislot ito para makita ng bata.
- May pulang bilang sa button ng Awards kung ilan ang medalyang naghihintay, kaya alam ng bata kahit nasa Home pa lang.

Mga Ayos

- Hindi na gumagalaw ang estante ng medalya kapag may kinukuha o naubos na ang naghihintay.

---

After updating

- Nothing to do now.
- For the next update, just tap "Update" in the app. The first time, allow E-Tarabay to install ("Allow from this source"), then go back to the app.
- You can delete the old E-Tarabay.apk files in Downloads to free up storage.

New

- Updates now happen inside the app. They no longer go through the website, and no E-Tarabay.apk files pile up in Downloads and fill the storage.
- From the next update on, only what changed is downloaded: usually a few MB instead of 117 MB.
- The update shows its size before it downloads, and its progress while it does.
- In Awards, one tap now claims a medal. A golden light, a sound and an unlock play, then the medal flies back to the shelf.
- A medal waiting to be claimed stays locked until it is taken, and wiggles so the child can spot it.
- The Awards button shows a red number for the medals waiting, so the child knows from Home.

Fixes

- The medal shelf no longer jumps when a medal is claimed or the last one is taken.
